# Get user data

The API endpoints described in this section return information about user accounts.

<!-- -->

## [Get public user data](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/user-get.md)

[/users/{userId}](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/user-get.md)

## [Get private user data](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-get.md)

[/users/me](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/users-me-get.md)
